crossRefs.note: A malicious man disguises himself with his lips, but he harbors evil in his heart.

people.name: Absalom
people.line: David's rebellious son who tried to usurp the throne.

people.name: Amnon
people.line: David's firstborn son, killed by Absalom

translations.web: But Absalom pressed him, and he let Amnon and all the king’s sons go with him.
translations.bsb: But Absalom urged him, so the king sent Amnon and the rest of his sons.
translations.kjv: But Absalom pressed him, that he let Amnon and all the king's sons go with him.
translations.asv: But Absalom pressed him, and he let Amnon and all the king's sons go with him.
